uncertainty: Pilot cell: two Python paths verified, dnspython and dpkt, ranked by PyPI Stats last-month downloads. pycares is excluded (c-ares channel API, no bytes parser) and scapy is excluded under this pilot's no-socket rule (its import opens AF_NETLINK sockets). dnslib, py3dns and pypacker remain leads. Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Package-level adoption metrics include non-DNS use; the remaining leads are unverified, and the cell is not a definitive top ten.
selection: Two control-verified Python DNS path(s), ranked by PyPI Stats last_month downloads excluding known mirrors: dnspython 2.9.2 (286,812,791), dpkt 1.9.8 (1,492,890).
